items.title: Claude Opus 5.5, GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, and a new price war
items.summary_1line: Yesterday was Grok 4.7 ( pelicans ) and MiMo v2.6 Flash/Pro ( more pelicans ). Today Anthropic released Claude Opus 5.5 , and around an hour later OpenAI released GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna . It's going to take a while...
items.why_it_matters: Matches feed focus: agentic, codex, claude code.
items.editor_note: GPT-6 Sol과 Luna는 Opus 5.5 출시 한 시간 후에 배치되어 가격 경쟁 구도를 형성합니다.

items.title: Introducing GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary_1line: Meet GPT-6.1 Sol: near-Astra intelligence for coding, computer use, and professional work at one-fifth of Astra’s standard API input and output token prices.
items.editor_note: OpenAI 의 출시 게시물: Astra API 가격의 5분의 1로 Astra에 버금가는 인공지능을 제공합니다.

items.title: GPT 6.1 Sol: Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price
items.summary_1line: My comment on GPT 6.1 Sol: Near-Astra intelligence for a fifth of the price — Hacker News. I'm a bit late with the pelicans because I was live-blogging the keynote: https://simonwillison.net/2026/Sep/29/openai-devday-...
items.editor_note: GPT-6.1 Sol 기조연설 및 가격 책정에 대한 실시간 블로그 댓글입니다.

items.title: Asana cuts model costs 76x in browser tests with GPT-6.1 Sol
items.summary_1line: Using GPT-6 Astra in Codex, Asana made its browser agent 76x cheaper and 5x faster in tests to offer customers more capable models.
items.editor_note: 최초 고객 수치: Asana의 브라우저 에이전트는 테스트 결과 76배 저렴하고 5배 더 빠릅니다.

items.title: Codex CLI Defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol, Cuts Price 80% [2026]
items.summary_1line: Codex CLI Defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol, Cuts Price 80% [2026] tech-insider.org
items.editor_note: Codex CLI 이제 GPT-6.1 Sol을 기본값으로 사용하며 가격이 80% 인하되었다는 추가 보고가 있습니다.

editorial.tldr: OpenAI shipped GPT-6 Sol and Luna on Sep 22, an hour after Claude Opus 5.5, as vendors cut prices. A week later GPT-6.1 Sol arrived with near-Astra intelligence at one-fifth of Astra's API token prices.
editorial.whats_new: A secondary report says Codex CLI now defaults to GPT-6.1 Sol and cuts price 80%; the claim is unconfirmed by OpenAI in this thread.
editorial.why_it_matters: GPT-6.1 Sol lowers the price of Astra-class coding and computer-use work, so routing and cost-per-task assumptions built on Astra pricing are out of date.
editorial.take_for_builders: Rerun your coding and computer-use evals on GPT-6.1 Sol against your current Astra baseline, comparing cost per completed task, before changing any default model.

status.detail: GPT-6.1 Sol has moved from launch to customer cost claims and a reported Codex CLI default.
